title: 第15章 武道真意

content_zh:
这山壁通道直通地底，像是被人开凿出来的，随着萧叶接近光源，通道尽头，一座不大的山洞浮现在视线中。
与此同时，一股热浪迎面扑来，灼热的温度瞬间让萧叶身上冒汗。
“这是地底的岩浆！”萧叶大吃一惊，原来那光源，居然是在山洞中心沸腾的岩浆。
“那是……”
突然，萧叶目光一凝，只见那沸腾的岩浆中，居然倒插着一把造型古朴的长刀，半露的刀身散发着幽幽寒芒，相隔老远，萧叶也能感到皮肤刺疼。
“好刀！”萧叶双目发亮，即使他见识有限，也能察觉这把长刀的不凡。
在岩浆中，还漂浮着不少巨石，萧叶踩着巨石，是可以拿起长刀的，但是他没有这么做，而是谨慎的观察起四周起来，因为蛮熊还没出现呢。
“嗯？”萧叶没有发现蛮熊，却发现一个身披长袍的骷髅，依着山壁靠着。
“难道这便是那位陨落的先天境强者？”萧叶走了过去，打量了一番这具骷髅，很快被骷髅身前的一块石板吸引了。
那石板上刻满了字迹，苍劲有力，字里行间有种悲凉。
“吾十岁修武，十五岁成为先天武者，那时意气风发，自认为从此同辈无敌，横推天下武者，笑傲苍穹。”
看到第一段话，萧叶便暗暗点头：“能在十五岁成为先天武者，此人的资质很不错，恐怕比赵乾还要强上一些。”
萧叶接着看下去。
“但吾师笑吾无知，先天之上，还有万夫莫敌的玄武之境，唯有问鼎玄武，才有资格称为强者。”
“吾三问吾师，如何问鼎玄武，吾师只说了武道真意四个字，便闭口不言。”
“吾不甘心，诚心拜访地位显赫的强者，最终得知，要问鼎玄武境，必须领悟出一种武道真意。”
“吾立誓要领悟出虚无缥缈的武道真意，问鼎玄武。但怎奈资质有限，苦修二十载，却连武道真意的皮毛都没有摸到。”
“就在吾绝望之际，却意外得到一把玄武境强者的玄兵，蕴含那位玄武境强者的武道真意。吾欣喜若狂，带着玄兵归隐山林，却因为受到仇家追杀，伤重将亡。”
“唾手而得的武道真意，吾却无法再领悟，不甘！不甘！”
看到最后的不甘两字，萧叶仿佛看到一位雄姿勃发的身影，对天长啸，发泄着自己的不甘。

“先天境界之上，是玄武之境……”萧叶目光闪烁，石板上的话语，带给他极大的震撼。
他生活的青阳镇，连先天境武者都没有，玄武之境和武道真意他更没有听说过了。
“玄武境强者使用的武器，被称为玄兵么？这下子真是走大运了！”萧叶心中激动起来。
很显然，倒插在岩浆中的那把长刀，便是蕴含了武道真意的玄兵。如果他得到，岂不是就有机会领悟那虚无缥缈的武道真意了？
那可是十五岁突破到先天境的天才，苦修二十载都无法领悟出来武道真意啊。
萧叶压下心头的激动，目光停留在骷髅的披风口袋上。
“一位先天境武者身上，肯定有些宝物，晚辈得罪了，前辈莫怪。”萧叶对骷髅鞠了一躬，伸手朝口袋掏去。
最后，他掏出了两个瓷瓶，还有两本册子。
萧叶视线不经意扫过瓷瓶上面贴着的标签时，浑身一震，如同被一道惊雷劈中，直接呆在原地。
补脉丹！
这三个字，倒映在萧叶瞳孔中，让他内心狂喜起来。
“没想到在这里，居然能得到补脉丹！”
他忘记不了，从小对他严厉的身影……
他忘记不了，刻入心底的落寞身影……
他忘记不了，柳依依拿出丹药，践踏他自尊的时候，那个挡在他身前的伟岸身影……
现在只要萧叶拿着补脉丹，就可以让萧阳恢复实力，再次成为萧家村村长以下的第一强者，他怎能不激动？
萧叶口气。要是这里面是空的，那萧叶就欲哭无泪了。
这个瓷瓶是珍贵的补脉丹，那另一个瓷瓶呢？
萧叶看向另一个瓷瓶的标签，上面写着回气丹三个字。
“回气丹？莫非是让先天武者恢复先天真气的丹药？”萧叶暗道，从瓷瓶中倒出两颗黑乎乎的丹药。

那丹药才一出现，一股精纯的气息便直冲过来，萧叶只是轻轻呼吸，便感觉体内的真气居然增长了不少。

content_en:
This mountain wall passage leads directly to the ground, as if it had been dug out by someone. As Xiao Ye approached the light source, a small cave appeared in sight at the end of the passage.
At the same time, a wave of heat rushed towards him, and the scorching temperature instantly made Xiao Ye sweat.
"This is the magma under the ground!" Xiao Ye was shocked. It turned out that the light source was actually the boiling magma in the center of the cave.
"That's..."
Suddenly, Xiao Ye's eyes narrowed, and he saw a simple long knife stuck upside down in the boiling magma. The half-exposed blade exuded a faint cold light. Xiao Ye could feel the tingling pain on his skin even from a long distance away.
"What a knife!" Xiao Ye's eyes were shining. Even with his limited knowledge, he could still detect the extraordinary nature of this long knife.
There were many boulders floating in the magma. Xiao Ye could have picked up the long knife by stepping on the boulders, but he did not do so. Instead, he carefully observed the surroundings because the wild bear had not appeared yet.
"Huh?" Xiao Ye didn't find the wild bear, but found a skeleton in a robe leaning against the mountain wall.
"Could this be the fallen Xiantian Realm expert?" Xiao Ye walked over and looked at the skeleton, and was quickly attracted by a stone slab in front of the skeleton.
The stone slab is full of writings, which are vigorous and powerful, and there is a sense of sadness between the lines.
"I practiced martial arts at the age of ten, and became an innate warrior at the age of fifteen. At that time, I was so high-spirited that I thought I would be invincible among my peers from now on. I would dominate the world's warriors and be proud of the sky."
After seeing the first paragraph, Xiao Ye nodded secretly: "To be able to become an innate warrior at the age of fifteen, this person's qualifications are very good, I am afraid he is better than Zhao Qian."
Xiao Ye continued to read.
"But my master laughs at my ignorance. Above the innate world, there is the realm of Xuanwu that is invincible. Only those who aspire to the top of Xuanwu are qualified to be called strong."
"I asked my master three times how to aspire to Xuanwu. My master only said four words about the true meaning of martial arts and then kept silent."
"I was unwilling to give in. I sincerely visited the powerful man with a prominent position, and finally learned that in order to achieve the Xuanwu Realm, I must understand the true meaning of martial arts."
"I vowed to understand the elusive true meaning of martial arts and aspire to be the master of Xuanwu. However, my qualifications are limited and I have been practicing hard for twenty years, but I haven't even scratched the surface of the true meaning of martial arts."
"Just when I was in despair, I unexpectedly got a Xuan Weapon belonging to a strong Xuanwu Realm master, which contained the true meaning of martial arts of that Xuanwu Realm strongman. I was overjoyed and took the Xuan Weapon back to the mountains and forests, but because I was chased by my enemies, I was seriously injured and was about to die."
"The true meaning of martial arts is at my fingertips, but I can no longer comprehend it. I am unwilling to accept it! I am unwilling to accept it!"
Seeing the last two words of unwillingness, Xiao Ye seemed to see a majestic figure roaring to the sky, venting his unwillingness.
"Beyond the innate realm is the Xuanwu realm..." Xiao Ye's eyes flickered, and the words on the stone tablet gave him a great shock.
In Qingyang Town where he lived, there were not even Xiantian realm warriors, and he had never heard of the Xuanwu realm and the true meaning of martial arts.
"Are the weapons used by strong men in the Xuanwu Realm called Xuan Weapons? This is really good luck!" Xiao Ye became excited.
Obviously, the long knife stuck upside down in the magma is the mysterious weapon that contains the true meaning of martial arts. If he gets it, wouldn't he have a chance to understand the true meaning of the illusory martial arts?
He was a genius who broke through to the Xiantian realm at the age of fifteen. He had been practicing hard for twenty years but could not understand the true meaning of martial arts.
Xiao Ye suppressed the excitement in his heart and his eyes stayed on the skeleton's cloak pocket.
"There must be some treasures in a Xiantian realm warrior. If this junior is offended, seniors should not be blamed." Xiao Ye bowed to the skeleton and reached into his pocket.
Finally, he took out two porcelain bottles and two booklets.
When Xiao Ye's eyes inadvertently glanced at the label on the porcelain bottle, his whole body was shocked, as if he had been struck by thunder, and he froze in place.
Pulse-tonifying pill!
These three words were reflected in Xiao Ye's pupils, making him feel ecstatic.
"I didn't expectHere, you can actually get the Pulse Replenishing Pill! "
He can't forget the figure who was strict with him since childhood...
He could not forget the lonely figure engraved in his heart...
He couldn't forget that when Liu Yiyi took out the elixir and trampled on his self-esteem, the majestic figure standing in front of him...
Now as long as Xiao Ye holds the Pulse Replenishing Pill, Xiao Yang can regain his strength and once again become the strongest person below the village chief of Xiaojia Village. How can he not be excited?
Xiao Ye's tone. If it were empty, Xiao Ye would be crying without tears.
This porcelain bottle is a precious pulse-boosting pill. What about the other porcelain bottle?
Xiao Ye looked at the label of another porcelain bottle, which had the words "Qi-Reviving Pill" written on it.
"Rejuvenation Pill? Could it be a pill that allows innate warriors to restore their innate true energy? "Xiao Ye secretly thought, pouring out two dark pills from the porcelain bottle.
As soon as the elixir appeared, a pure breath rushed over. Xiao Ye just breathed lightly and felt that the true energy in his body had increased a lot.
